carried_by: the Ocarina import's local pipeline: link.materials from ocarina-material-pack.coax and scene.materials from the kokiri material, atlas and foliage packers, read by the bundle and pack tools. A file between two steps of one import on one computer; no client or server reads it
header: "OCM1", version 1, the record count (1 to 1024), the texture layer count (1 to 2048), 16 zero bytes
body: records of 256 bytes (64 words) to the file's end: words 0 to 7 sampler layers numbered from 1 (0: no texture), 16 the material's kind, 17 its render mode, 18 and 19 its alpha cut and roughness, 20 to 59 colours, texture matrices and scalars, 60 and 61 two more sampler layers, 62 a terrain flag
rules: the file is exactly the header and its records
a count of 0, or past 1024 records or 2048 layers, is refused
the header's last 16 bytes are zero
what a record's words mean is each tool's; the reader checks the header and the length

fixture.source: two records over three layers: a masked material with three samplers, and a terrain material with one sampler and a second map (ocarina-material-profile.coax omp_build, its header written by ocm_head_put)

refused.what: a byte set in the header's zero bytes
